import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Torgerson': 'Torgersen', 'Bisco': 'Biscoe'})
    # Fix sex label variants (case)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    # Fix body_mass_g: parse text numbers (remove thousands separator)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Handle out-of-range body_mass_g values (set to NaN so they don't skew the mean)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result.to_dict()
